en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal spa square with manicured hedges, paths, benches, and large potted plants in the foreground. Behind the garden is a long colonnaded building with shops or facilities, and a larger historic spa building with a clock and flagpole on the roof in the background. Trees surround the complex, giving it a park‑like setting. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Bad Elster and specifically the bathing place (Badeplatz).
